profile.summary: Jocil Limited manufactures and sells stearic acids, fatty acids, soap noodles, toilet soaps, glycerine, and industrial oxygen in India. It operates through Chemicals, Soap, and Power segments. The company offers Oleochemicals, such as stearic acid, distilled fatty acids, fractionated fatty acids, and refined glycerine; and soaps, including toilet soap, noodles, and special products.
